---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Before you begin

Before opening a new feature request, please search existing issues and discussions to see if the idea has already been proposed.

## Problem statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the current limitation or pain point.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or change you would like to see. Be specific about the behavior, CLI flags, TUI interactions, or output format if applicable.

## Use cases

Provide concrete examples of how this would be used:

1. As a user, I want to ... so that ...
2. ...

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Willing to contribute?

- [ ] I would like to implement this feature and open a pull request

## Additional context

Mockups, screenshots, or references to similar tools are welcome here.
